theme: Theme 2 — Parent-facing: why coding before university (calendar/moyacode-themes.md)
theme_note: Theme 1 ('Don't just wait for results') was used 2026-06-10, so Theme 2 was selected per the variation rule.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: template.html embedded the literal placeholder string "__SPEC_PLACEHOLDER__" inside a JS object literal (`window.SPEC = window.SPEC || { "__SPEC_PLACEHOLDER__" }`), which is invalid JS syntax. This threw a SyntaxError on page load before window.READY could be set, causing render_video.js's `page.waitForFunction('window.READY === true')` to time out at 30s.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Replaced the placeholder with the actual design-spec.json content (content + timeline) embedded as a valid JS object literal, so the template works standalone for static mode and the injected window.SPEC (via evaluateOnNewDocument) still takes precedence in video mode.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: Stat #2 used data-v="1-on-1" with the countUp animation. The countUp regex strips all non-digits (`1-on-1` -> `11`), parses to 11, then replaces the FIRST digit run in the original string with 11, producing the garbled result "11-on-1" / "11-ON-1" in both the PNG and MP4 final frame.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed stat #2 to {"v":"100%", "l":"PERSONAL MENTORSHIP"} (and matching markup data-v="100%" / label "Personal Mentorship"), which counts up cleanly to "100%" and reinforces the 1-on-1 mentorship message without breaking the regex. Updated both design-spec.json and template.html (markup + embedded SPEC).
